entities.text: Ganesh Prasad vs The State Of Bihar on 10 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After 10 years of marriage, a frivolous and concocted complaint has been filed making general and omnibus allegation against the petitioners.

Learned Magistrate without considering the nature of allegation against the petitioners, has taken cognizance against them only because they happen to be the father-in-law and mother-in-law of the complainant/opposite party no. 2.
The cognizance has not been taken against the other family members of the petitioners.
He further submits that the petitioners are very old persons aged about 71 years and 60 years respectively.

5. Considering the aforesaid, issue notice to the opposite party no. 2 by both processes i.e. ordinary as well as registered cover/speed post with A/D for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks from today, failing which this application shall stand dismissed without further reference to a Bench.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.32480 of 2025(2) dt.10-06-2025 6.

List this case under appropriate heading on 21.07.2025.
7.
In the meantime, further proceedings of Complaint Case No. 2310 of 2024, pending before learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Motihari shall remain stayed as against the petitioner.

(Anil Kumar Sinha, J.) priyanka/-
